text.tspan: Full scored taxonomy; DATE excluded. Synthetic datasets only. Default track.
Each row: same documents, clean sets, languages both claim; rows use different subsets.
Points: macro differences. Whiskers: paired bootstrap 95% intervals.
Intervals are not adjusted for multiple tests.
Tested SCT v0.8.2. Results do not measure v0.8.3. Source: round 2, 2026-11-04.
